candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get fever, and the fever don dey for 2 days. Body temperature na 38.0°C. E no dey convulse now and e never get convulsion before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Malaria test dey and the result na positive. Malaria risk dey low. Dem no see any obvious cause of fever, and dem never see any identified bacterial cause. Pikin never get measles in the last 3 months and e no get measles cough. E no get generalized rash. E eye no red, e no get runny nose, and e neck no stiff. Pikin no get cough or difficult breathing, e no get diarrhoea, and e no get ear problem.
